# `person_version`

Effective-dated person attributes with recorded time (EMP-08). Append-only except closing the open version.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | people |
| Kind | version |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `effective_from`, `effective_to`, `recorded_at` |
| Retention class | `employment-record`: Personnel history retained after employment ends per the legal pack and tenant policy (NFR-05, DOC-17). Period: comes from an approved pack, none exists yet. |
| API mapping | /v1/people/{id}/versions (planned) |
| Write path | people repository createPerson / appendPersonVersion. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0003_people (expand). New attributes arrive as nullable columns (expand), backfilled (migrate), then made required (contract). |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- FK (tenant_id, person_id) -> person
- effective_to >= effective_from
- no overlapping intervals per person (exclusion constraint)
- only an open version may be closed; closed history is immutable
- birth_date >= 1900-01-01
- audit required (resource = person_id)
